title: M4FC: a Multimodal, Multilingual, Multicultural, Multitask Real-World Fact-Checking Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (F1 scores) on the verdict prediction task disaggregated across 10 different languages to evaluate cross-lingual generalization and performance disparities.

Analyzing the geographic distribution of image locations in the dataset by continent and country, and comparing it against previous datasets to demonstrate reduced Western-centric bias and broader cultural representation.

Comparing verdict prediction performance between a balanced dataset setting (containing synthetic true claims) and an imbalanced setting (real claims) to verify if models exploit superficial linguistic heuristics, such as claim length and the frequency of named entities.
